shadow_watches.trigger: After 09:45 ET, hold 212.70 on controlled reset; completed 5-minute close > 219.00, regular-session VWAP and 15-minute opening-range high, spread <=0.30%, 5m volume >=1.5x prior 5-bar median.
shadow_watches.historical: N=3 up-session analogs, D+5 -0.03%; 3/5 positive-gap open-to-close fades
shadow_watches.skip: Cancel if 212.70 loses, spread>0.30%, 15m ORH > the reference trigger, no VWAP reclaim, or 8:30 CPI-driven selloff broadens.

shadow_watches.trigger: After 09:45, pullback 5.10–5.45 holds 5.00; completed 5-minute close >5.85, above RTH VWAP and 15-minute ORH, spread <=0.35%, rising healthcare participation.
shadow_watches.historical: N=17 prior >=4% sessions, D+5 +4.93%; 4/7 positive opening gaps faded
shadow_watches.skip: Cancel if no reset, 5.00 breaks, spread >0.35%, news details shift, or blow-off spike before confirmation. Stop assumes no slippage; never approved.

shadow_watches.trigger: After 09:45 rebound toward 40.30–40.90 fails RTH VWAP and completed 5-minute close below 39.50 and the opening-range low.
shadow_watches.historical: N=2 prior <=-3% sessions, D+5 +4.30% rebound risk
shadow_watches.skip: No priced spread / option liquidity / verified settled buying power, invalidation >41.10 or insufficient margin-rule permission.

shadow_watches.trigger: After 09:45 rebound 54.35–55.25 fails VWAP, then completed 5-minute close below 52.60 and 15-minute ORL.
shadow_watches.skip: No fresh priced option vertical or if 55.80 recaptured; cancel without OR confirmation.
